Ravi (People Ops): Hey @Jordan — quick logistics for Weds Day 1. I-9 pop-up kiosk on 2nd floor from 8:45-10:15. Bring either passport OR passport+SS card OR driver’s license + birth cert. If you have an expired passport but a renewal receipt, bring that and we can do an exception. Background-check vendor sent intake link this morning — pls finish before 6pm tonight so the vendor can kick off.
Jordan Lee: Thanks! Two qs: 1) My passport is in courier, ETA tomorrow AM. 2) I live out of state — can I do I-9 remotely via an approved notary? 
Ravi (People Ops): Re: courier passport — if it arrives before kiosk window you can use it. If not, bring a government photo ID and birth certificate and we'll file an I-9 remote exception. For remote hires we require an authorized notary or an HR-approved authorized representative. Fill the exception request form (link sent) and CC me.
IT Support: @Jordan we'll have your laptop ready at the IT desk by 12pm. Please confirm Mac vs Windows and preferred accessories. We'll pre-provision Okta + Slack. If you need a local docking station, note it in the intake form.
Jordan Lee: Mac please. Also my phone number changed recently — should I update in the onboarding form or here?
Ravi (People Ops): Update the onboarding form (it feeds into badge and benefits). I'll sync with Mailroom for badge courier if needed.
Mailroom (Facilities): FYI — if you need badge couriered, we can send via tracked courier to your address same-day, but must have photo ID verified first. Courier cutoff 3pm.
onboard-bot: BG check status for Jordan Lee: intake received. Vendor ticket BG-7890 created. Expected turnaround 24-48 hrs. Reminder: missing SSN will delay.
Jordan Lee: I don’t have SSN yet (newly moved), will that block background check?
Ravi (People Ops): It will delay the criminal check portion. We can still start identity verification and verify other items. Please add a note in the intake form and we’ll mark it as 'awaiting SSN' so it doesn’t block badge provisioning completely.
Jordan Lee: Ok added the note. One more: when is benefits orientation?
Ravi (People Ops): Benefits walkthrough at 2pm (mandatory for full-time). Recorded session link posted after. If you want to enroll Day 1 bring dependent names + DOBs + SSNs. If anything urgent, we can set a 1:1 later today. :wave:
